Event

Struct-like variants that expand.

pub enum Event {
    /// Expands because a field has a comment.
    Started {
        /// The run identifier.
        id: u64,

        name: String,
    },

    /// Expands because its one-line form is too wide.
    Finished {
        identifier: u64,
        summary: String,
        duration_in_milliseconds: u128,
